description: 행정안전부 한국지역정보개발원_(전국 통합데이터) 초정밀버스 위치 실시간 정보 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부 한국지역정보개발원. 전국 자치단체에서 운행중인 버스 이용자들의 이동 편의를 목적으로 현재 전국 자치단체에서 운행중인 버스의 운행관련 실시간 정보의 제공을 위해 지자체 코드, 지차체 명, 노선아이디, 노선. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부 한국지역정보개발원. Its tags are 초정밀버스, 실시간 버스 정보, 버스 노선정보, 버스 경유지 정보, 버스정보 GNSS. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
